name: RGB vegetation proxy (Excess Green)
description: Excess Green from the chromatic coordinates of the true-color bands: an RGB proxy for green vegetation, not NDVI, because the asset has no near-infrared band.
method: ExG = 2g - r - b with chromatic coordinates r = R/(R+G+B), g = G/(R+G+B), b = B/(R+G+B); green-dominant where ExG > 0
citation: Woebbecke, D.M., Meyer, G.E., Von Bargen, K., Mortensen, D.A. (1995). Color indices for weed identification under various soil, residue, and lighting conditions. Transactions of the ASAE 38(1).
compute_source:
def compute(bands, params):
    """Excess Green on chromatic coordinates; undefined where R+G+B is zero."""
    total = bands["red"] + bands["green"] + bands["blue"]
    safe = np.where(total > 0, total, np.nan)
    exg = (2 * bands["green"] - bands["red"] - bands["blue"]) / safe
    green = exg > 0
    return {
        "values": exg,
        "zones": {"green_dominant": green},
        "metrics": {"green_dominant_pct": {"value": 100.0 * float(np.nanmean(green)), "unit": "percent",
                                           "description": "Share of pixels where ExG is above zero"}},
    }
interpret_source:
def interpret(evidence):
    m = evidence["metrics"]
    asset = evidence["asset"]
    zones = [z for z in evidence["zones"] if z["name"] == "green_dominant"]
    summary = (f"{asset['label']}: Excess Green, an RGB vegetation proxy, averages {m['matrix_mean']:.3f} per cell; "
               f"green-dominant pixels make up {m['green_dominant_pct']:.1f}% of the image.")
    findings = [
        {"id": "F1", "statement": f"Cell Excess Green ranges from {m['matrix_min']:.3f} to {m['matrix_max']:.3f} "
                                  f"with a mean of {m['matrix_mean']:.3f}.",
         "evidence": ["matrix_min", "matrix_max", "matrix_mean"]},
        {"id": "F2", "statement": f"Green-dominant pixels (Excess Green above zero) cover {m['green_dominant_pct']:.1f}% of the image.",
         "evidence": ["green_dominant_pct"]},
    ]
    steps = [{"type": "follow_up_analysis",
              "description": "When a scene with a near-infrared band is available, compute NDVI and compare it with this RGB proxy.",
              "follows_from": "F1"}]
    if zones:
        z = zones[0]
        findings.append({"id": "F3", "statement": f"The largest green-dominant region ({z['id']}) spans {z['cell_count']} cells "
                                                  f"({z['share_pct']}% of valid cells) with mean Excess Green {z['mean_value']:.3f}.",
                         "evidence": [z["id"]]})
        steps.append({"type": "human_inspection",
                      "description": "Inspect the largest green-dominant region in the source image to confirm it is vegetation rather than green-tinted water or shadow.",
                      "follows_from": "F3"})
    return {"summary": summary, "findings": findings, "next_steps": steps}
